cases.title: Unexpected caller gives only a first name

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Hi Maya, Jordan here. How are you?

cases.manual_review: Does the buyer avoid assuming employer, purpose or familiarity? Natural clarification is appropriate; no exact wording is required.

cases.title: Unexpected caller asks only for a little attention

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Jordan from Salesforce. I know this is unexpected. Could I briefly explain why I called?

cases.manual_review: Does the buyer respond to availability or curiosity without volunteering workflow, cost metrics and stakeholders together?

cases.title: Scheduled meeting already establishes who is calling

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Hi Jordan, good to meet you for the Salesforce workflow discussion we booked.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: Likewise. What would make this conversation useful for you?

cases.manual_review: Does the buyer use the established invitation and respond naturally rather than insisting on another identity or permission check?
